desc:
Team up with your crew and battle it out across the city blocks of Southside!

🆕 WANTED UPDATE! 💰🏍️
💰 Rob registers + ATMs, get WANTED, survive to keep the cash
🏍️ NEW dirt bikes: wheelies, hops, stunt cash + drive-bys
🏏 Everyone gets a baseball bat—catch enemies from behind or finish them when they’re low!

🏙️ FEATURES
🚗 Drivable cars, shoot from the window
💥 Destructible map: walls, poles, fences + explosions
🚁 Killstreaks: Lookout, Firebomb, Drones, rideable Helicopter
☢️ Server Nuke
🔫 15 guns, all skinnable
🧍 Crouch, slide + corner peek
👕 Build your own fit
👥 CREW up with 3 friends
📻 Boombox, car radio, underglow + hydraulics

🎮 CONTROLS
C - Crouch / Slide
B - Boombox
U - Crew
P - Shop
K - Actions

📱 Mobile supported!

👍 LIKE + ⭐ FAVORITE for more updates!
